messages:
Sara: Hey team — Pastel Ridge story check-in. Interview is locked for tomorrow 11:00am PT. Need owners for quote pre-clear, short clip + transcript redaction, hero metric for the launch post, and inbound routing for the webinar. Can we assign?

Mike: I can own the launch post copy + coordination. Assigning quote pre-clear to @Lee and clip/transcript to @Ana. Jordan can you confirm the hero metric numbers?

Jordan: On it. I'll pull the benchmark run and validate numbers by EOD. Expecting the final delta for cost/latency from run `pr-2026-run3`.

Lee (Legal): Copy — I'll review the proposed quotes. Send me verbatim lines you want to use. Legal prefers pre-approved language for customer quotes. Also need signed release from Pastel Ridge before publish.

Ana: I'll do the 30s social clip and transcript redaction. Can someone drop the raw recording link + rough timecodes? Preferable to have the highlight timestamped.

Sara: Raw recording link: https://files.redwood/pastelridge/rec123 (internal). Highlight at ~00:06:20-00:06:50 for the low-latency bit.

Mike: Draft quote we want to propose: ```"With Redwood Inference we cut inference cost by 42% and P95 latency from 1.8s to 0.6s" — Pastel Ridge, CTO```

Lee (Legal): Suggestion: swap to conservative phrasing until Jordan confirms numbers. Example: ```"With Redwood Inference we saw approximately 40% lower inference cost and a substantial reduction in p95 latency" — Pastel Ridge, CTO``` I can pre-clear that immediately. Also tagging legal-bot for checklist.

legal-bot: Automated check: missing signed release form. Please attach `pastelridge_release_signed.pdf` before publication.

Jordan: Confirmed numbers from `pr-2026-run3`: cost reduction = 41.8%, p95 latency from 1.82s -> 0.61s. I'll sign off on the 42%/0.6s wording OR we can use rounded conservative copy per legal.

Lee (Legal): OK to approve the exact numbers if Jordan attaches the benchmark CSV and a short methodology note. Otherwise we'll go with "approximately 42%" and "~0.6s p95".

Ana: Got the raw & timecodes. I'll produce the 30s cut + the redacted transcript by tomorrow noon. For transcript redaction, do we omit customer-specific IP mentions? Pastel Ridge flagged their model names as sensitive.

Sara: Yes redact model names and internal product IDs. Customer asked to keep the overview + hero numbers, not the internal names.

Nina (Sales Ops): For webinar registrants routing — confirm we want AE assignment = mid-market queue + campaign = PR-Pastelridge-May. I'll set up the SFDC campaign and a Zap to push registrants to the campaign with lead source = webinar_pastelridge.

Mike: That sounds right. Also want a secondary tag `bench-interest` if they click the benchmark PDF. Nina can you add that as a conditional?

Nina (Sales Ops): Yep — will add `bench-interest` if `download=benchmark_pdf` within 24h of registration. I'll share the Zap config in #sales-ops when done.

Sara: Final publishing plan: webinar Wed 2pm PT. Post (long-form + hero image + benchmark summary) goes live same day after webinar wrap. Social clip goes up concurrently. Legal sign-off and release file must be attached before publish.

Mike: I'll queue the draft post now and leave placeholders for numbers until Jordan uploads CSV.

Jordan: Uploading CSV + methodology to `benchmarks/pastelridge/` now. File: `pr-2026-run3-results.csv`.

Lee (Legal): Received. Approving exact numbers and quote as drafted. Please attach signed release to thread before publish. :thumbsup:

Sara: Great — tasks recap: Mike copy, Lee legal sign-off (done), Ana clip+redaction, Jordan bench CSV (done), Nina routing (in progress). If nobody objects, plan to publish Wed after webinar.

Ana: On track. Will post final assets here when ready.

Nina (Sales Ops): Zap + SFDC campaign set up, will confirm ID shortly.

Sara: Awesome — thanks team. Closing loop tomorrow after the interview. :party_parrot:
